name: Single-cell Chromatin Benchmark
description: Evaluates and compares computational methods for single-cell chromatin data analysis across datasets and performance metrics.
evaluation_method: metric-dependent (ARI, NMI for clustering; AUPRC/F1 for classification; precision/recall for peak calling)
reputation: Well-regarded within the single-cell method-development community as a comparative benchmark for chromatin-focused single-cell tools.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; results are dataset- and metric-dependent. Susceptible to batch effects, dataset heterogeneity, and overfitting to specific preprocessing pipelines.
